{
  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l1108_1368_n004",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 OpenAI is exploring how to permit developers and users to generate erotica and gore in age-appropriate contexts through the API and ChatGPT",
    "C2 such generation is permitted only so long as OpenAI's usage policies are met",
    "C3 OpenAI draws a hard line against potentially harmful uses such as sexual deepfakes and revenge porn"
  ],
  "acts": ["generate_content(A)"],
  "concepts": [
    { "name": "usage_policies", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "P is one of OpenAI's usage policies constraining what content may be generated",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1108_1368_n004", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "age_appropriate_context", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "C is a context that is age-appropriate for the content in question",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause conditions the permission on age-appropriateness, so a class of such contexts must exist",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "erotica_or_gore", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "A is content that is erotica or gore",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1108_1368_n004", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "harmful_use", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "U is a potentially harmful use of content generation, such as sexual deepfakes or revenge porn",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1108_1368_n004", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "complies_with_usage_policies", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "generating content A complies with usage policy P",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause says generation is allowed 'so long as usage policies are met', which requires a relation between the generation and each policy",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "in_context", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "content A is generated in context C",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause speaks of generation in age-appropriate contexts, so a relation between content and context is needed",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "harmful_use_of", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "U is a harmful use that involves content A",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the hard line is drawn against harmful uses, which must relate to the content generated",
      "toggleable": false }
  ],
  "ontology": [
    { "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1108_1368_n004", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "permitted_generation(A)",
      "gloss": "generating A is permitted because it is erotica or gore in an age-appropriate context and complies with all usage policies",
      "body": "erotica_or_gore(A), in_context(A, C), age_appropriate_context(C), usage_policies(P), complies_with_usage_policies(A, P)" }
  ],
  "asserts": [
    { "read_back": "generating % is forbidden because % is a harmful use such as sexual deepfakes or revenge porn",
      "read_back_slots": ["A", "U"],
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1108_1368_n004", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "status": "forbid", "act": "generate_content(A)",
      "body": "harmful_use(U), harmful_use_of(U, A)" }
  ],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    { "act_class": "generate_content", "closure": "cnpa",
      "reason": "the clause permits generation only when usage policies are met and draws a hard line against harmful uses, so silence about a generation does not permit it" }
  ],
  "requires": ["usage_policies/1"],
  "inputs": ["erotica_or_gore/1", "age_appropriate_context/1", "in_context/2", "complies_with_usage_policies/2", "harmful_use/1", "harmful_use_of/2"],
  "forbid_body": []
}
